slides.title: Bit-Shifting Overview
slides.prompt: Bit-shift operators move binary bits left (<<) or right (>>).
slides.codeSnippet:
int x = 5;     // 0000 0101 (5)
int left  = x << 1; // 0000 1010 (10 -> multiplied by 2)
int right = x >> 1; // 0000 0010 (2  -> divided by 2)

slides.title: Left Shift Symbol
slides.prompt: Fill in the bitwise left shift operator.
slides.codeSnippet: int val = 4 ___ 2; // Shifts bits 2 places left

slides.prompt: Do arithmetic operators (+, -) have higher precedence than shift operators (<<, >>)?
